# snipeit_category (Resource)

Manages a category in Snipe-IT. Categories classify assets, accessories, consumables, components and licenses.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category_type` (String) Type of the category. One of `asset`, `accessory`, `consumable`, `component` or `license`. Changing this forces a new category.
- `name` (String) Name of the category. Must be unique per category type.

### Optional

- `checkin_email` (Boolean) Send email to users on checkin/checkout of items in this category.
- `eula_text` (String) EULA text (Markdown) shown for items in this category.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `require_acceptance` (Boolean) Require users to confirm acceptance of items in this category.
- `use_default_eula` (Boolean) Use the instance-wide default EULA instead of `eula_text`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the category.
